name: Valentina Shevchenko

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (65 in height, 66 in reach); 124.6 lb at the UFC 322 weigh-in (Nov 2025)

photo_coverage: Good. Studio headshot and full-body cutout photographed for a 2026 fight week (CDN date Oct 2026), a Sep 2024 cutout in a sports bra (tattoos), two Nov 2025 weigh-in photos, three Nov 2025 fight photos (near-frontal face, left near-profile, full body). Four Commons files are freely licensed (2018 and 2020 CC BY 3.0 video stills; two 2016 U.S. Air Force public-domain photos, one a right near-profile). Her latest fight in data/derived/fighters.json is UFC 322 (Nov 2025).

face.shape: Broad oval face, a little wider than average at the cheekbones, tapering to a rounded chin. Fuller-cheeked in 2016-2020; leaner and more defined in 2025-2026.
face.jaw: Moderately wide with soft, rounded angles; a clean jaw line in the 2025-2026 photos.
face.chin: Rounded, medium width and average height; not prominent.
face.cheekbones: Broad and high: the widest part of the face. The cheeks flush pink-red easily (ESPN studio).
face.brow_ridge: Low to moderate. The brows sit close to the eyes.
face.forehead: High, broad and smoothly rounded. The hair is always pulled back tight, so the whole forehead shows.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium size, slightly hooded at the outer corners; faint lines under the eyes

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight with a soft arch over the outer third; set low
eyebrows.colour: light ash-brown, darker than the hair (raw sample #9e503e includes skin)

face.mouth_lips: Medium-small width. Thin upper lip, medium lower lip; a slight closed-mouth smile at rest.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No: smooth ears in the 2016-2020 close-ups.
ears.note: Close to the head; small earrings in non-fight photos.

face.notable_marks_scars: Freckles on the shoulders, upper chest and arms (Sep 2024 cutout). No obvious facial scars.

hair.style: Long hair always pulled straight back: a high, tight ponytail for weigh-ins and media; for fights, tight braids from the hairline (cornrow-style, Nov 2025 photo a) or two to three boxer braids (Nov 2025 photo b).
hair.length_note: Ponytail falls past the shoulders to about mid-back (2016 photo).
hair.colour_note: Dark honey-blonde with slightly darker roots and lighter, golden lengths. Raw samples: 2016 ponytail #7c6642 (lit strands #8e7a56); Nov 2025 weigh-in ponytail #775124 (lit strands #a28252, warm light).

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit, near-neutral cheek and forehead-free patches); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.undertone: Cool-to-neutral pink; cheeks and nose flush red.
skin.freckles_marks: Fair skin with freckles on the shoulders, chest and arms; light down only.
skin.note: Fair skin with a pink undertone. The ESPN studio cheeks are flushed (#e68a70, #ea8f73), the 2020 still is slightly yellow; the average of the two lands near the true tone. Shadowed samples are excluded.

body.build: Compact, athletic flyweight: 165 cm, 56.5 kg (124.6 lb at the Nov 2025 weigh-in). Muscular but not bulky.
body.body_fat_note: Clear six-pack and oblique lines at the Nov 2025 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Rounded, muscular deltoids; moderately broad for her frame
body.arms: Toned, visibly muscular upper arms and strong forearms; reach 167.6 cm
body.legs_calves: Strong, muscular thighs (a kicker's legs), defined knees and calves
body.posture: Upright with a very straight back; often stands side-on in a southpaw stance
body.notable: Southpaw. Thick, muscular neck for her size.

tattoos.where: left upper arm, outer side below the shoulder
tattoos.description: Black circular emblem (a round medallion with a figure inside, about 5 cm across) with a line of Thai script under it

tattoos.where: left side of the abdomen, lower ribs
tattoos.description: Black pistol (Glock-style handgun) with the muzzle pointing toward her centre line and three bullet cartridges standing below the muzzle; about 10-12 cm

tattoos.where: right side of the abdomen, from the lower ribs toward the hip
tattoos.description: Thai-style line-art figure (a robed deity/warrior figure in sak yant style) with small dagger/flame marks around it and a base line beneath; about 12-15 cm tall. New: absent in the Sep 2024 cutout, present at UFC 322 (Nov 2025).
Thin black patterned band around the ankle, about 2 cm wide

kit.fight_shorts: UFC 322 (Nov 2025): dark green/teal Venum sports bra and shorts with a gold tiger and dragon print and a Monster Energy logo; red-cuffed gloves. Noche UFC (Sep 2024): green Mexican-themed kit with gold SHEVCHENKO lettering and gold gloves. 2026 ESPN cutout: black crypto.com/Venum jersey with gold accents and olive-grey tiger-print shorts.

morphs_extra_macro.note: Outside the requested morph list but in the shipped manifest; needed for a female athlete's build. Use if the avatar code supports them (src/avatar3d.js macroWeights has cupSize and firmness).

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs. Her ears are close to the base mesh, so none are suggested.

morphs_unavailable: Height: the research/assets.md height fit (heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875) is for the male base, so no heightUpF/heightDownF value is given; build her at the female default height and nudge macro/heightUpF or heightDownF until the mesh reads 165 cm. No target for the braids/ponytail, freckles or tattoos (texture work).
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (broad high cheekbones, rounded chin, high forehead with hair pulled back, dark-honey-blonde ponytail or braids, medium-brown eyes, fair pink skin with freckled shoulders, compact muscular build, the three torso/arm tattoos); medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) she is a woman: use the F macros (sexF 1; sexM 0) and keep the face soft-angled, not masculinised by the muscle macro; (2) tattoo sides: pistol on the LEFT abdomen, Thai figure on the RIGHT abdomen (new since 2025), emblem with Thai script on the LEFT upper arm, band on the RIGHT ankle; (3) hair is never loose in fights: braids for fight scenes, ponytail for weigh-ins; (4) southpaw stance (right foot forward); (5) do not make the hair platinum: it is a darker honey-blonde.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/valentina-shevchenko.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn_stance_left.png, espn_stance_right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Kickboxing counter striker: upright, back-weighted, circles and counters.
